definition.description: Claims PENDING rows from AI CoE Case Command (UI<->flow contract v0.1.1, binding A), executes the five operations against the canonical lists, writes receipt + event rows, and returns the response JSON to the command row. Identity = the row's Author. Polls every 5 minutes.
